apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
apps.versionDescription:
Nuvio 0.6.0 | nuvio-0.6.0-full-release

- [feat(party): add experimental watch parties (#2253)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2253) @tapframe  
- b9d2c39d fix(player): pause other apps audio on android @tapframe  
- [feat(mdblist): show dynamic and liked lists in the library (#2268)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2268) @kernexshadow  
- [i18n(el): translate new 0.5.10 strings (#2263)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2263) @nosvasedis  
- [Complete missing Italian translations (#2260)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2260) @WhiteGiso  
- [fix(ios): improve PiP transitions and recover playback after closing PiP (#2259)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2259) @WhiteGiso  
- [fix(ios): restore Now Playing by limiting audio mixing to calls (#2246)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2246) @WhiteGiso  
- [fix(i18n): update, complete and review Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) localization (#2234)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2234) @jhojhocraazy  
- [feat(mdblist): show external lists in the library (#2172)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2172) @kernexshadow
